questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to Dr. Zakir Husain, which is the prime instrument of national purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ke anusar rashtriya uddeshya aur rashtra nirman ka sabse mukhya sadhan shiksha (education) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain delivered his speech in the year ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ne yeh bhashan 1967 mein rashtrapati pad ki shapath lene ke turant baad diya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain was a great ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ek mahan rashtravadi (nationalist) aur swatantrata senani the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who said that 'Bharat is my home and its people are my family'?
questions.explanation: Yeh prasiddh kathan Dr. Zakir Husain ka hai jab unhone poore desh ko apna parivar bataya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'For .......... size the tasks ahead of us are so demanding.'
questions.explanation: Speech ki mool line hai: 'For sheer size the tasks ahead of us are so demanding'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The family is big and is constantly .......... at a rather inconveniently fast pace.
questions.explanation: Bhashan mein kaha gaya hai ki yeh rashtriya parivar asuvidhajanak tez gati se badh (growing) raha hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'I have just taken the oath of loyalty to the .......... of India.'
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ne Bharat ke Samvidhan (Constitution) ke prati nishtha ki shapath li thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain delivered his speech in 1967 after taking the oath as the ..........
questions.explanation: Unhone Bharat ke teesre Rashtrapati (President) ke roop mein shapath lene ke baad yeh bhashan diya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain felt greatly obliged to the people of ..........
questions.explanation: Weh Bharat (India) ki janta ke aabhari the jinhone unhe desh ke sarvochha pad par chuna.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to Dr. Zakir Husain, the past is not ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Husain kehte hain ki hamara ateet mara hua ya thhahra hua (dead and static) nahi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain became the President of India in ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain 13 May 1967 ko Bharat ke teesre Rashtrapati bane the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... was the role model of Dr. Zakir Husain.
questions.explanation: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan unke aadarsh (role model) the jinki vidwatta ki unhone prashansa ki.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Bharat is My Home' is written by ..........
questions.explanation: 'Bharat is My Home' Dr. Zakir Husain ke 1967 ke bhashan ka mukhya ansh hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... is the prime instrument of nation building.
questions.explanation: Rashtra ke vikas aur sanskritik unnati ke liye shiksha (education) mukhya aadhar hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'The family is big and is constantly growing at a rather inconveniently fast pace' is from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh pankti Dr. Zakir Husain ke path 'Bharat is My Home' se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'The people have chosen to make me the head of this family for a certain time.' Who says this?

options.B: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

questions.explanation: Yeh baat Dr. Zakir Husain ne Rashtrapati banne ke baad janta ke prati aabhar jatate huye kahi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which type of prose piece is 'Bharat is My Home'?
questions.explanation: 'Bharat is My Home' gadhya ki vidha mein ek bhashan (speech) ka ansh hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain was born in .......... and died in ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ka janam 1897 mein aur dehavsan 1969 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain was born in ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ka janam Hyderabad shahar mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Radhakrishnan never lost his faith in the .......... of man.
questions.explanation: Dr. Radhakrishnan ne manavta ki moolbhoot aatmiyata (essential humanity) par kabhi vishwas nahi khoya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain sees two aspects of work — social and ..........
questions.explanation: Karyon ke do pehlu hote hain: vyaktigat (individual) aur samajik (social).

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain was the .......... and Dr. Radhakrishnan was the .......... President of Bharat.
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain teesre (3rd) aur Dr. S. Radhakrishnan doosre (2nd) Rashtrapati the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain had also championed the right of all men to live in ..........
questions.explanation: Unhone pratyek manushya ke garima (dignity) aur samman se jeene ke adhikar ka samarthan kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How long did Dr. Zakir Husain live?
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ka jeevankal lagbhag 72 varsh (1897 se 1969) ka tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the tenure of Dr. Zakir Husain as the President of India?
questions.explanation: Unhone 13 May 1967 se lekar apne nidhan 3 May 1969 tak rashtrapati ke roop mein karya kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain pledges himself to the service of the totality of India's ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Husain ne Bharat ki samast sanskriti (totality of India's culture) ki sewa karne ki shapath li.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: As President, Dr. Zakir Husain was preceded by ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain se pehle Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Bharat ke rashtrapati the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain sees .......... aspects of work.
questions.explanation: Unhone kaam ke do mukhya pehlu bataye: aatm-vikas aur samajik sewa.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: On which occasion did Dr. Zakir Husain deliver this speech?

options.A: Taking oath as Governor of Bihar
options.D: Taking oath as the President of Bharat

questions.explanation: Yeh bhashan Bharat ke Rashtrapati ke roop mein shapath lene ke avsar par diya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Radhakrishnan brought to the Presidency a .......... equipment.
questions.explanation: Dr. Radhakrishnan ne rashtrapati pad par mahan bauddhika aur manasik upkaran (mental equipment) pradan kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain entered the office in a spirit of .......... humility.
questions.explanation: Unhone prarthnamay vinamrata (prayerful humility) aur nishtha ke sath padbhar grahan kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the speech, the past is described as ..........
questions.explanation: Hamara ateet jeevit aur gatishil (alive and dynamic) hai jo hamare bhavishya ko nirdharit karta hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The word 'erudition' stands for ..........
questions.explanation: 'Erudition' ka taatparya gahri vidwatta ya mahan gyan (great knowledge) se hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Radhakrishnan explained .......... exceptionally throughout his life.
questions.explanation: Dr. Radhakrishnan ne Bhartiya darshan (Indian philosophy) ko vishva star par adbhut tareeqe se samjhaya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain was long associated with the field of ..........
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ka lamba sambandh shiksha (education) ke kshetr se raha tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The people had chosen him the head of the family for ..........
questions.explanation: Janta ne unhe ek nishchit samay (a certain time) ke liye is rashtriya parivar ka mukhya chuna tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: As President, Dr. Husain advocated for the growth of ..........
questions.explanation: Rashtrapati ke roop mein unhone kisi ek varg nahi balki sampoorna rashtra ke vikas ki vikalat ki.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: This sincere effort will give to the life of our State a special ..........
questions.explanation: Line hai: 'This effort will give to the life of our State a special flavour'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The word 'peril' stands for ..........
questions.explanation: 'Peril' ka arth gambhir sankat ya khatra (serious danger) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The word 'pledge' stands for ..........
questions.explanation: 'Pledge' ka taatparya shapath lena ya sankalp karna (swear) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The end-product of work on one's self is a free ..........
questions.explanation: Aatm-vikas ka aakhiri nishkarsh ek swatantra aur naitik vyaktitva (free moral personality) ka nirmaan hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: We can neglect the end-product only at our ..........
questions.explanation: Hum naitik vyaktitva ke nirmaan ki andekhi keval apne khatre (at our peril) par hi kar sakte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: We will have to work without distinction of caste, colour and ..........
questions.explanation: Hamein jaati, rang aur dharam-mat (creed) ke bhedbhav ke bina rashtra nirmaan mein judna hoga.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: We shall each one of us have to participate .......... in building its new life.
questions.explanation: Pratyek nagrik ko bina kisi aalas ya sankoch ke poore samarpan (unsparingly) se bhag lena hoga.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'I must confess that I am .......... by the trust my people have placed in me.'
questions.explanation: Dr. Husain kehte hain ki janta ke vishwas se weh bhav-vibhोर ya abhibhoot (overwhelmed) hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: No one can afford to sit back and just watch or let frustration become .......... in our country.
questions.explanation: Desh mein nirasha ko sthayi aadat (endemic) nahi banne diya ja sakta.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: During his lifetime, .......... remained devoted to the pursuit of knowledge and truth.

options.C: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

questions.explanation: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan aajiwan satya aur gyan ki sadhna mein samarpit rahe.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Dr. Zakir Husain awarded the highest civilian award 'Bharat Ratna'?
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ko saal 1963 mein Bharat Ratna samman se nawaza gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Dr. Zakir Husain honoured with the 'Padma Vibhushan'?
questions.explanation: Unhin saal 1954 mein Padma Vibhushan se sammanit kiya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: From which foreign university did Dr. Zakir Husain earn his Ph.D. degree?
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ne University of Berlin (Germany) se economics mein doctorate ki degree li thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who succeeded Dr. Zakir Husain as the President of India after his demise?
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain ke asamayik nidhan ke baad V. V. Giri rashtrapati bane the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Before becoming the President of India, Dr. Zakir Husain served as the Governor of ..........
questions.explanation: Rashtrapati banne se pehle weh Bihar ke rajyapala (Governor) ke roop mein sewa de chuke the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the academic background and profession of Dr. Zakir Husain besides being an educationist?
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain prashikshit arthashastri (economist) aur mahan shikshavid the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why does Dr. Zakir Husain call India 'the young state of an ancient people'?

options.A: Because the population consists only of young children
options.B: Because a newly independent modern state inherits an ancient timeless culture
options.C: Because the country was founded recently
options.D: Because ancient traditions have been discarded

questions.explanation: Desh naya swatantra rashtra hai lekin iski sanskriti hazaaron saal pracheen aur samriddh hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Quoting Mahatma Gandhi, Dr. Zakir Husain asserts that power should be used only for .......... purposes.
questions.explanation: Gandhi ji ka manna tha ki shakti ka upyog naitik uddeshya (moral purpose) aur lok kalyan ke liye hona chahiye.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did Dr. Radhakrishnan never cease to champion throughout his life?

options.A: The right of all men to live in dignity and with justice

questions.explanation: Dr. Radhakrishnan ne hamesha manav adhikar, nyay aur sammanpoorvak jeevan jeene ka samarthan kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to Dr. Zakir Husain, individual work and social work are ..........
questions.explanation: Vyaktigat vikas aur samajik vikas ek doosre ke purak hain aur sath-sath chalte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the antonym of the word 'dynamic' as used in 'alive and dynamic'?
questions.explanation: 'Dynamic' (gatishil) ka vipritarthak shabd 'Static' (sthir/thhahra hua) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the closest synonym of the word 'humility' as used in the speech?
questions.explanation: 'Humility' ka arth namrata ya vinamrata (modesty) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the cause of Dr. Zakir Husain's untimely death on 3 May 1969?
questions.explanation: Rashtrapati karyakal ke dauran hridayaghat (heart attack) se unka aakasmik nidhan hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Dr. Zakir Husain was the .......... President of India to die while in office.
questions.explanation: Dr. Zakir Husain pehle aise Rashtrapati the jinka nidhan unke karyakal ke dauran hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the fundamental business of education according to Dr. Zakir Husain?

options.B: To promote the growth of national culture and develop national character
options.C: To train students only for government jobs
options.D: To replace moral values with modern machinery

questions.explanation: Shiksha ka mukhya uddeshya rashtriya sanskriti aur rashtriya charitra ka vikas karna hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: From which university did Dr. Zakir Husain obtain his Master of Arts (M.A.) degree?
questions.explanation: Unhone apna M.A. University of Allahabad se poora kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: From which university did Dr. Zakir Husain complete his Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) degree?
questions.explanation: Unhone apna graduation (B.A.) University of Lucknow se kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did Dr. Zakir Husain compare the diverse cultural threads forming the national integrity to?

options.C: Fibres of different cultures forming a single fabric

questions.explanation: Unhone vibhinn sanskritiyon ki tulna alag-alag tantuon (fibres) se ki jo milkar ek majboot kapda banate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'endemic' in the phrase 'let frustration become endemic'?

options.B: Regularly found and deeply ingrained among people

questions.explanation: 'Endemic' ka arth kisi bimari ya dushpravritti ka logon ke beech sthayi roop se bas jana hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the primary tone of Dr. Zakir Husain throughout 'Bharat is My Home'?
questions.explanation: Bhashan ka swar atyant gambhir, rashtrabhakti se paripoorna aur sewa-bhav se yukta hai.
